task.description: Hard gate: review the WF-02 batch 7 implementation (DDL-04, OBP-04, ORD-03, VLD-04) against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. New/changed files: src/platform/backfill.zig (DDL-04 backfill loop with ctid ANY batches), src/outbox/gate.zig (OBP-04 hysteresis gate), src/ordering/cursor.zig + consumer.zig + sweeper.zig (ORD-03 order guard + gap sweeper to DEAD/DLQ), src/validation/gate.zig (VLD-04 validation gate + verdict), src/dlq/store.zig (EFFECT_CORRELATION item type), and migrations 1163-1166. Check: SQL parameterization on all new queries (especially the DDL-04 backfill ctid ANY subquery with $1 batch-size param and the ORD-03 cursor advance with $1/$2), no catch unreachable on realistic DB failure paths, tenant-scoping of the new tables (plat_migration_state, plat_outbox_gate, definition_semantic_verdict -- are these per-tenant via search_path like plat_effect_completion, or cross-tenant?), whether the backfill/sweeper/gate code runs with elevated/platform-level DB access and whether that is appropriate, and that no secret material is introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant checked against the diff
SQL parameterization verified including the DDL-04 ctid ANY backfill subquery and ORD-03 cursor advance
Tenant-scoping requirement for the three new tables explicitly assessed
Backfill/sweeper/gate DB access level assessed for appropriateness

result.summary: HARD GATE PASS — WF-02 batch 7 (DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04) security review against the numbered invariants. APPLIED + SATISFIED: INV-1 (tenant isolation), INV-4 (no secrets), INV-6 (this review), INV-7 (SQL parameterisation), INV-8 (no catch unreachable). NOT APPLICABLE: INV-2 (no new/changed API response structs in diff), INV-3 (no Lua/Wasm host-API changes), INV-5 (no new lookup-by-ID handlers). SQL parameterisation verified: DDL-04 backfill wraps the platform-generated ctid-ANY batch (batch size bound as \; the only interpolations are the strict [a-zA-Z0-9_]-validated table/column into the remaining-count query and integer config literals into SET LOCAL); ORD-03 cursor advance is fully parameterised (\ correlation_id / \ new_seq / \ prev_seq); sweeper, outbox gate, and validation gate all use 	-ord placeholders. No catch unreachable in any of the 7 changed files; all DB/parse failures return typed errors. Tenant-scoping: plat_migration_state (1163) and plat_outbox_gate (1164) are PER-TENANT platform control tables (unqualified name, default migration scope, live in every tenant schema via search_path, matching the plat_effect_completion/effects_outbox precedent); 1165 adds verdict columns to the PER_TENANT process_definitions (guarded); 1166 seeds the PER_TENANT event_type_registry (guarded). None are business tables under public — lint_migration_schema.py 0 violations, lint_sql_table_refs.py OK, lint_sql_param_types.py 0 issues. DB access level: backfill/gate/consumer/sweeper are platform worker / migration-runner paths operating through tenant-scoped pool connections (schema-per-tenant isolation preserved); the only cross-tenant writes are EXECUTION_*/DEFINITION_* platform events appended to public.events with platform sentinels, exactly matching event_store.Store.appendPlatform's documented convention ('Platform events are cross-tenant; public schema holds all three event tables'). Elevated platform access is appropriate and does not defeat INV-1. No secret material introduced: greps for client_secret/password hardcoding clean, event payloads carry only schema names/UUIDs/counters/compiler version.
